openai_fallback_structured_denial.pre_fix: scripts/openclaw-configure-shared-model-pool.sh registered openai/gpt-5.6-sol and openai/gpt-5.5 with agentRuntime.id='codex'. In OpenClaw 2026.7.1, agentRuntime.id='codex' selects the Codex app-server harness, which unconditionally rejects structured-extraction (tools.deny=['*'], tools.exec={'security':'deny','ask':'always'}) with 'Codex app-server local execution is not available when tools.exec.mode=deny'.
openai_fallback_structured_denial.post_fix: openai/gpt-5.6-sol and openai/gpt-5.5 now use agentRuntime.id='openclaw', and openclaw-gateway binds CODEX_HOME=/home/pantheon-assistant/.codex plus /home/node/.codex -> /home/pantheon-assistant/.codex so OpenClaw's embedded HTTP/OAuth runtime resolves existing product Codex OAuth credentials without spawning codex app-server while preserving tools.deny=['*'] and tools.exec={'security':'deny','ask':'always'}.

anthropic_primary_api_and_workspace_bind.pre_fix: scripts/openclaw-configure-shared-model-pool.sh registered anthropic/claude-opus-4-8 with agentRuntime.id='claude-cli' (subscription CLI backend) and scripts/openclaw_isolated_model_bootstrap.py required only PANTHEON_OPENCLAW_CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN without binding ANTHROPIC_API_KEY or anthropic-workspace-id.
anthropic_primary_api_and_workspace_bind.post_fix: anthropic/claude-opus-4-8 now uses agentRuntime.id='openclaw', ANTHROPIC_WORKSPACE_BATCH binds models.providers.anthropic.headers.anthropic-workspace-id to the unresolved '${ANTHROPIC_WORKSPACE_ID}' env reference, docker-compose.yml passes PANTHEON_OPENCLAW_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY -> ANTHROPIC_API_KEY and PANTHEON_OPENCLAW_ANTHROPIC_WORKSPACE_ID -> ANTHROPIC_WORKSPACE_ID into openclaw-gateway, and .github/workflows/nonprod-deploy.yml isolated-l12-provider-qualification passes secrets.DEV_OPENCLAW_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY and vars.DEV_OPENCLAW_ANTHROPIC_WORKSPACE_ID.

adapter_structured_routing.change: services/openclaw-gateway-adapter/assistant_openclaw_provider.py defaults invoke_structured agent_id to STRUCTURED_AGENT_ID ('structured-extraction'), rejects non-structured agent_id with 422 OPENCLAW_STRUCTURED_AGENT_NOT_ALLOWED, omits X-OpenClaw-Model when model is None so the Gateway executes primary anthropic/claude-opus-4-8 with automatic fallback to ['openai/gpt-5.6-sol', 'openai/gpt-5.5'], and forwards X-OpenClaw-Model plus output.active_model when an explicit model is requested.

pinned_gateway_2026_7_1_reproduction.method: Local ghcr.io/openclaw/openclaw:2026.7.1 gateway container against a local deterministic synthetic HTTP server (no external LLM calls or live credentials).

pre_fix_codex_runtime_under_structured_e.gateway_log_error: Codex app-server local execution is not available when tools.exec.mode=deny

credential_and_environment_boundary.ci_isolated_qualification_primary: Uses GitHub dev environment secret DEV_OPENCLAW_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY and variable DEV_OPENCLAW_ANTHROPIC_WORKSPACE_ID=wrkspc_018oMz2BRKkweHbBE9MsJ1u9 via PANTHEON_OPENCLAW_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY and PANTHEON_OPENCLAW_ANTHROPIC_WORKSPACE_ID.
credential_and_environment_boundary.openai_fallback_auth_boundary: No OpenAI CI secret is claimed created; OpenAI fallback models (openai/gpt-5.6-sol, openai/gpt-5.5) use existing VM-mounted product assistant OAuth credentials under /srv/pantheon-assistant/.codex (/home/pantheon-assistant/.codex in openclaw-gateway).
